Geographies Served Programs Livelihood Programme Srujna trains women from low-income families in the trades of textiles, jewellery, food and handicrafts also exposing them to leadership, business insight, financial skills and soft skills. It makes efforts to find out markets for the products made by the women by promoting them, creating catalogues, finding large orders, conducting exhibitions and raising awareness of handmade products among the public. Healthcare Programme The organisation takes care of the healthcare of its women through conducting regular complete body and eye check-ups besides creating awareness of menstrual hygiene and distributing sanitary pads among them. Education Programmes Women who want to achieve further independence and realise their dreams are given opportunities to train themselves in English speaking, digital literacy, financial literacy, leadership training, sales training, office assistant training, tally accounting and product development. Awareness Programme Srujna also seeks to empower women by generating awareness among them about domestic violence and encouraging them to learn self-defence making them informed and confident to face life.
